# Luxembourg

> Benchmark chips for Luxembourg cut from the harmonized field boundary collection for Luxembourg (edition 2026).

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/lu_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/lu_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/lu_fields.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/lu/items.parquet)
